# Stage Registry
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this file as the single source for the configured workflow's ordered stage roles and quality-stage paths.

## Stage Order

| Order | Role | Stage path | Required | Handoff or purpose |
|---:|---|---|---:|---|
| 1..n | Production | [assigned during Build Stage] | Yes | Declared production output |
| n+1 | Measure | [assigned during Add Quality] | Yes | `audit-findings.md` and quality decision |
| n+2 | Learn | [assigned during Add Quality] | Yes | `what-now.md` and next action |

## Registry Rules

- Production stages appear in execution order.
- Measure and Learn are always the final two roles.
- Stage paths are workspace-relative and use the configured folder names.
- A route, handoff, correction, or resume reference uses this registry instead of repeating a role path elsewhere.
- Setup progress, decisions, and validation status are recorded in `setup/initialization-record.md`.
